body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics displayed its next generation Duo HD player ‘BD-UP50000’ during KES 2007, which supports both HD-DVD and Blu-ray disc formats, and their interactive technologies. Adopting HQV(Hollywood Quality Picture) processor chip, 7.1-channel and Dolby Digital Plus, it features HDMI 1.3 av receiver and Samsung's Anynet+ technology enabling you to network your home via one remote controller.
